srList.sentence: Materials and methods Study design and participants The study designs for SELECT-EARLY (NCT02706873) and SELECT-MONOTHERAPY (NCT02706951) phase 3 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) have been described in detail elsewhere [14, 17].

srList.sentence: MTX-IR patients received oral or parenteral MTX for ≥4 months at a stable dose for ≥4 weeks before enrolment and had active RA when they were randomized 1:1:1 to blindly discontinue MTX and receive UPA 15 mg or 30 mg daily as monotherapy plus placebo MTX or continue their previous dose of MTX monotherapy as a blinded study drug plus UPA placebo.

srList.sentence: Data analyses Least square mean ( LSM ) changes from baseline to week 12 ( SELECT-EARLY ) or from baseline to week 14 ( SELECT-MONOTHERAPY ) were calculated based on an analysis of covariance and mixed effect repeated measures model , respectively .

srList.sentence: Comparisons between groups were made using chi-squared tests with statistical significance at the 5% level.
